questions.question: Before the battle at Ramoth-gilead, King Ahab told King Jehoshaphat what each of them would wear. What was the plan?

answers.text: Ahab goes disguised and Jehoshaphat wears royal robes
Both kings go into battle in disguise
Both kings go into battle in royal robes

questions.question: In the battle at Ramoth-gilead, a man shot an arrow without taking special aim. Who did the arrow strike?
After an arrow wounded King Ahab of Israel in battle, when did he die?
After King Ahab died in battle, dogs licked up his blood at the pool of Samaria. This happened just as what?

answers.text: The word the LORD had spoken
The curse a stranger had spoken
The vow the elders had spoken
